purpose: Direct target-gp17 near-homolog screening on all receptor-cohort nucleotide records; no phenotype or model inference
tblastn_format: 7 qseqid sseqid pident qstart qend qlen sstart send sframe bitscore evalue

gp17_near_match.rule: Any single local alignment meeting both thresholds excludes its complete source container via the explicit nucleotide-record-to-primary-ID map; no HSP coverage summation

broader_gp17_family_diagnostic.role: Report only; no automatic broad-family exclusion or clearance

input_integrity: Reverify every original container Git blob, normalized file hash and separate record sequence hash; preserve all multirecord boundaries and ambiguous DNA bases
Protein absence or annotation failure never removes available DNA
Require makeblastdb to report every one of the 270 source/control records, both outfmt7 query completions and both corresponding original-reference gp17 self controls
Reverify source, policy, helper, executable and target hashes before and after execution
missing_or_failed_inputs: Retain all candidate failure rows; do not execute a partial cohort or treat unassessed/no-hit rows as independent
admission: Direct near-hit flags only; no whole-genome relatedness graph, homology-free training, stock identity, host-range, binding, assembly or model-run authorization
